notes: Calories-only chain, 15 cafes in 3 menu tiers (Menu 1 = 8 cafes, Menu 2 = 4, Menu 3 = 3, from booths.co.uk/dining-by-booths/booths-cafe). Compared all 79 kcal figures of Menu 1 against the PDF pages 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 rendered at 150 dpi and read by eye (a different route from the script's pdftotext bounding-box reading); a Tesseract pass over the same renders matched 61 of the 79 numbers on its own (misses and misreads were the dense two-column layout) and every one of the 79 was then confirmed by eye: 0 mismatches. Names, sections and the toast / preserves option lines match the pages. Menus 2 and 3 were read the same way by script: every figure on them (72 and 66) is on Menu 1 with the same value, so no dish prints two values (Menu 2 lacks 7 hot-food items, Menu 3 lacks 13). Printed without kcal and not listed: Pastries and counter cakes, Yogurt Pouches, Pip Organic, Frobishers, Coca-Cola, Franklin & Sons, Harrogate Water, Prosecco, Afternoon Tea. The menu's vegetarian/vegan icons are pictures and were not turned into tags (only the two dishes whose own name says Vegetarian are tagged). 'Scrambled Egg on Toast' prints 912 kcal beside the smashed avocado on toast's 431 and the little scrambled egg on toast's 455: copied as printed.
